entities.name: Chada
entities.description: A sergeant in the kentsu from the Empire of Madara, sole-surviving among soldiers who attacked the Sylvan Library by running.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: The army in which Chada served.

entities.name: Gunamo
entities.description: A vicious Ærathi commander whose orders Chada struggled to follow.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Gave the kentsu the choice to run or fight.

events.summary: Chada was the only survivor of the soldiers that attacked the Sylvan Library.
events.quote: Chada was the only survivor of the soldiers that attacked the Sylvan Library

events.summary: Ayesha Tanaka gave the kentsu the choice to run or fight, and Chada ran.
events.quote: Chada was one of the few who ran

relations.note: He was a sergeant under Commander Gunamo.
relations.quote: had some trouble following orders from the vicious Ærathi Commander Gunamo
